title: 伊什塔尔 · 天舟玛安娜的巡空·「看好了，这就是女神的领空」
description: 【群山云海上空·白昼】白色天舟Maanna掠过云层，伊什塔尔稳稳站在前端，一手叉腰俯瞰远方的山脊。金色耳环与王冠在阳光下闪耀，黑色双侧束发随风扬起。她回头得意地招呼同行者欣赏这片高空景色。
action: 立于天舟船首叉腰俯瞰，金饰灼灼黑发飞扬
lighting: 高空烈阳与云海反光的强对比
camera: wide dynamic shot, boat prow, cloud sea, goddess framing
promptProse: Ishtar stands securely at the forward section of the large white heavenly craft Maanna as it passes above a sea of clouds and distant mountain ridges. One hand rests on her hip while the other steadies her stance against the craft’s structure. Her black goddess outfit, golden tiara and hoop earrings catch the high sunlight, with dark two-side-up hair moving in the wind. She looks out with an exuberant, proud smile. Use a wide view that connects the figure, supported feet and Maanna clearly, with no lettering.

title: 伊什塔尔 · 现代街头的女神考察·「人类的甜甜圈……是供品吗」
description: 【现代都市街头·午后】牛仔外套与白色短上衣搭配高腰短裤，伊什塔尔举起吃了一半的甜甜圈，眼睛亮得像发现了宝藏。今天王冠换成星形发夹，她边走边得意地宣布，下一份考察清单还要多加几种甜点。
action: 举甜甜圈眼睛发亮，牛仔外套短上衣，边走边咬
camera: medium shot, street walking, donut in hand, cheerful mood
promptProse: Walking along the afternoon street, Ishtar holds up a half-eaten donut and turns toward the viewer with delighted red eyes. A denim jacket, white crop tee, high-waisted shorts and sneakers keep the modern outfit casual, while a star-shaped hairpin sits above her dark hair. Her free hand makes an enthusiastic little gesture as she presents this latest discovery of human desserts. Bright shopfront reflections catch her hoop earrings and dark hair. Frame the donut, hairpin and clear walking posture together, without readable shop signs or lettering.

title: 伊什塔尔 · 神殿供品的清晨·「今天的供品，本女神勉强收下了」
description: 【重建的神殿·清晨】晨光穿过重建的神殿廊柱，你摆在她座前的供品是一份热腾腾的早餐。伊什塔尔盘腿坐在座台上，闻着香气眼睛都直了，却还要端着架子清清嗓子——「哼、这份心意本女神收下了。作为回礼……今天一天，你的运气由本女神亲自罩着。感恩吧，凡人。」
action: 盘腿坐座台前收供品，闻香眼亮，端架子清嗓
camera: medium shot, seated goddess, offering table, morning glow
mood: 女神口嫌体正直、晨间甜
promptProse: Ishtar sits cross-legged on the rebuilt temple dais with both hands resting on her knees as the aroma of a freshly placed breakfast reaches her. The tray remains on the low offering table in front of the seat, with warm steam rising from the bowl. Her golden tiara and black goddess outfit retain the formal appearance despite the plainly hungry look in her red eyes. Morning light enters between the columns and brightens the food and relaxed posture. Keep the seated figure and offering table central, with no lettering.

title: 伊什塔尔 · 冥界圣诞的来访·「姐姐的东西，本女神先看看」
description: 【冥界·圣诞夜】以「慰问妹妹」之名，伊什塔尔拎着一大袋圣诞礼物踏进了冥界的雪原。她把包装精美的盒子塞到你手里，红瞳别向一边——「给、给你的。人类世界流行这个……本女神只是入乡随俗！啊，艾蕾要是问起来，就说是一半的一半，分她的那半另算！」
action: 礼物袋放在脚边，双手递出包装好的礼盒，红瞳别向一边
lighting: 冥界幽蓝雪光与礼物缎带的暖金
camera: medium shot, snowfield gift, blue-gold contrast, tsundere mood
promptProse: On the snowy underworld plain, Ishtar offers a neatly wrapped Christmas box with both gloved hands while looking bashfully to the side. The larger sack of presents stands beside her boots, leaving her hands free for the gift. A warm white coat, red scarf and long trousers replace her summer street clothes; the star-shaped hairpin remains above her dark hair. Blue snowlight catches the wrapping while a nearby lantern supplies a small warm glow. Frame the complete handover pose and grounded gift sack, with no readable labels or lettering.

title: 伊什塔尔 · 金色花嫁的圣约·「女神下嫁，空前绝后」
description: 【想象婚礼·巴比伦式圣殿】伊什塔尔穿着金线绣纹的纯白长婚纱走过圣殿廊柱，王冠换成花冠。她一手轻提裙边，一手伸向同行者，红瞳里既得意又有些不敢置信。这段女神婚礼作为场景创作中的想象誓约，不宣称是神史上首次婚姻。
action: 金线白纱行进花冠在首，红瞳得意又恍惚
lighting: 圣殿金柱折射的辉煌光
camera: wide shot, processional portrait, gold-lined chapel, bride walk, epic mood
promptProse: In an imagined temple wedding, Ishtar walks between the golden Babylonian-style columns in an opaque white gown embroidered with gold thread. A flower crown rests beneath the long veil. One hand gathers the gown’s edge while the other reaches toward the viewer, her red eyes bright with a mixture of triumph and shy disbelief. Warm reflected light follows the embroidery and the careful forward step. Show the complete formal silhouette, offered hand and floral headpiece within the vertical frame, without lettering.

title: 伊什塔尔 · 星空下的真心话·「金星……是我最喜欢的一颗」
description: 【神殿屋顶·日落后】伊什塔尔与你并肩躺在平整的屋顶平台上，指向西方低空明亮的金星。天边的余晖尚未散尽，几颗较亮的星已显现。她难得放轻了声音，说起爱与战争之外那些不擅表达的心事。
action: 并肩躺看星空指金星，红瞳柔软低语
lighting: 西方地平线残留的暮光与神殿暖灯
camera: wide two-shot, two clothed figures reclining and Venus low in western twilight
promptProse: After sunset, Ishtar and a fully clothed companion recline side by side on a broad, flat temple rooftop, looking toward Venus low in the western sky. She raises one hand to indicate the bright planet while her other arm rests beside her. Her black goddess outfit and golden tiara remain in place; the companion’s simple travelling clothes distinguish the second figure. A few bright stars appear as the twilight fades, and warm temple lamps edge the roof. Use a horizontal two-shot that includes the pointing gesture and low horizon, with no lettering.
